lines.text: When the LORD restores Judah and Jerusalem, He will bring all the nations down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat to judge them.
The LORD calls out Tyre, Sidon and Philistia for carrying off His treasures and selling the people of Judah to the Egyptians.
The LORD will sell their sons and daughters to the people of Judah, who will sell them to the Sabeans.
The nations are told to beat plowshares into swords and to advance to the Valley of Jehoshaphat, where the LORD will sit down to judge.
A spring will flow from the house of the LORD to water the Valley of Acacias, while Egypt and Moab become desolate.
